scope: ASAR raw bytes plus every app.asar.unpacked file; ZIP/ASAR inventory; local developer home/workspace literal paths in original/lower/upper case, slash and JSON-escaped variants, UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. No general secret proof or whole Electron binary scan.

credentialPrefixCheck.scope: Per-ASAR-file ASCII bounded high-confidence prefixes, including unpacked native entries; no raw values printed. Does not establish absence of all possible secrets.
